title: From Weeks to Hours: GenAI Logo Prototyping
blurb: Client-facing generative AI for logo concepts, with studio style families, guided prompts, multi-round iteration, and auth and cost tracking on AWS. Designers focus on refinement, not endless first drafts.
result: Concept turnaround cut from weeks to hours

meta.industry: Creative tooling, generative AI for design

whoFor: Design studios and agencies that spend a disproportionate amount of time on early-stage logo concepting before a designer ever touches refinement work.
challengeIntro: The earliest stage of a logo project, generating enough varied first-draft concepts to react to, eats real designer hours without needing a designer's judgment yet. Clients want options fast, but every round of first drafts competes with the refinement work that actually needs a professional eye.
challengePoints: Early concepting consumed disproportionate designer time relative to its value.
Clients expected fast turnaround on initial directions before committing to one.
Ad hoc AI tools did not reflect the studio's actual style families or process.
No cost or usage visibility as generation volume grew across clients.
identifiedIntro: The opportunity was not to replace designers with generative AI, it was to move the point where a designer gets involved further downstream, past the earliest, lowest-judgment drafts.
builtIntro: Covison built a client-facing generative AI tool for logo concepting on AWS, including:
builtPoints: Studio-defined style families to keep output on-brand
Guided prompts so clients could direct concepts without design expertise
Authentication and cost tracking per client
whyNotOffTheShelf: General-purpose image generators produce logo-shaped output with no concept of a studio's specific style families, no client-facing guided flow, and no built-in usage accounting the studio could bill against.
productionReality: Deployed as a client-facing tool, not an internal-only prototype.
Runs on AWS with authentication and per-client cost tracking in place.
Supports multiple rounds of iteration rather than one-shot generation.
outcomeBullets: Concept turnaround moved from weeks to hours.
Designers spend more time on refinement and less on generating first drafts.
Studio can offer faster initial turnaround without adding headcount.
